title: Initiative Clockwork: SLI alignment and rollback matrix for reliability initiatives
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Summary: Build an operational playbook ("Initiative Clockwork") and an alignment matrix that ties initiative workstreams to SLIs, SLOs, error-budget allocations, and explicit rollback gates. Aim: reduce ambiguity during SLO regressions and automate gating signals in the initiative tracker so product and engineering can make consistent go/no-go decisions.

Problem statement: We currently have fragmented approaches to error budget consumption across teams. Different owners interpret SLO thresholds and rollbacks inconsistently, which slows down mitigation and causes uneven prioritization of reliability work. There is no standard matrix for classifying severity, remediation steps, and roll-forward vs rollback actions tied to initiative/OKR status.

Goals: 
- Define a reproducible matrix that maps SLIs -> SLO tiers -> error-budget bands -> recommended initiative actions (throttle, pause, rollback, expedite).
- Embed matrix and gating checks into the initiative tracker so roadmap UI surfaces live error-budget state and recommended actions.
- Create a lightweight runbook and review cadence that clarifies ownership for mitigation, communication templates, and postmortem expectations.

Out of scope: full automation of rollbacks in the runtime; we will produce human-in-the-loop gating and automated alerts only for now.
acceptance_criteria: Draft alignment matrix published as a single-page artifact and linked from the initiative tracker
Initiative tracker shows live error-budget state for each tracked initiative (green/amber/red) based on upstream telemetry
Playbook defines explicit rollback gating language and three example remediation paths for each error-budget band
PM/Engineering sign-off on decision taxonomy and communication templates
At least two pilot initiatives adopt the gating matrix for the next cycle
comments: 2026-03-01 Priya Patel: Kickoff meeting notes attached to Confluence: outlined scope, stakeholders (SRE, Runtime Eng, Product, Design). Agreed to keep automation minimal for initial rollout; focus on clarity and adoption.

2026-03-03 Diego Morales: Drafted the initial matrix. Key decision: map SLO attainment to three bands (SLO met, warning: error budget < 30%, critical: error budget < 10%). Proposed actions tied to each band: advisory, pause new feature rollouts, rollback risky changes. Attaching link to draft: https://confluence.redwood/reliability/initiative-clockwork-draft

2026-03-04 Samir Rao (SRE): Raised concern about metric noise causing flapping between bands. Suggested adding a 15m sustained window and a secondary check (5xx rate + p99 latency) before triggering amber/critical. Added to matrix with threshold gating.

2026-03-05 Design review (Ava Chen): Recommended UI affordances to surface gating state in the initiative tracker: colored badge, tooltip with root cause summary, and a 'take action' dropdown that links to runbook steps.

2026-03-06 Priya Patel: Held alignment session with Growth and Platform PMs. Added two example communication templates: customer-facing status and internal steering update. Action: create an on-call notification template for SRE team to reduce triage overhead.

2026-03-07 Diego Morales: Built a prototype integration that reads error-budget signals from the SLO ledger and surfaces a computed band in the initiative tracker for pilot initiatives. Demo recording: https://drive.redwood/demo/initiative-clockwork-prototype.mp4
2026-03-09 Security review note (Nicole James): No new credentials required for read-only SLO signals. Recommend adding audit log entry when a gating action is taken; added as a follow-up sub-task.
2026-03-10 Priya Patel: Requesting PM sign-off. Please review the matrix and the two pilot initiatives assigned in the tracker. Next: runbook dry-run with SRE on 2026-03-12 and retro on 2026-03-20.

Runbook dry-run with SRE and runtime on 2026-03-12
Enable pilot flag in initiative tracker for two initiatives and monitor for one cycle
